name: com.sweeplessinseattle/quote
title: Sweepless in Seattle
description: Request a free house cleaning quote from Sweepless in Seattle, a Seattle cleaning company.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Send a house cleaning quote request to Sweepless in Seattle for a customer who asked for one. Covers Seattle, the Eastside and the South Sound. The request goes straight into the business scheduling system, and they reply to the customer with a flat, upfront price within one business day. Confirm the details with the customer before calling, and call once per quote.

email.description: Customer email. At least one of email or phone is required.

phone.description: Customer US phone number, any format. At least one of email or phone is required.

street.description: Street address of the place to be cleaned, including unit number.

city.description: City, for example Seattle, Bellevue, Kirkland.

service.description: recurring = Recurring home cleaning; deep = Deep cleaning; move = Move-in / move-out cleaning; rental_turnover = Airbnb / rental turnover; apartment = Apartment or condo cleaning; office = Office / commercial cleaning; other = Other / not sure

frequency.description: one_time = One time; weekly = Weekly; biweekly = Every two weeks; monthly = Monthly

bedrooms.description: Number of bedrooms. Use 0 for a studio.

square_feet.description: Approximate finished floor area of the home in square feet. A rough estimate is fine.

preferred_timing.description: When the customer would like the cleaning, in their words, for example "a Saturday in mid-November".

details.description: Anything else that affects the price or the visit: pets, parking, access, areas to focus on.

customer_consent.description: Set to true only if the customer asked you to request this quote and agreed to be contacted about it by phone, text, or email.
